description: This file defines the IStorageManager interface within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. It declares methods for managing storage related to applications, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage.

classes.name: IStorageManager
classes.description: An interface for managing application storage, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a specified application ID, returning the storage path or an error reason.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage location, size, and usage information for a given application ID.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specified application ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specified application ID, including device storage.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all application data except for exempted app IDs, including device storage.

calls: Core::hresult CreateStorage(const string&, const uint32_t&, string&, string&)
